description: Ask for an obligation of a run's locked contract to be changed. This only files a request (a line in the run's ledger, free, nothing is sent to any model); it decides nothing. Name the contract version you read, the obligation id, a reason (at most 500 characters) and the words you propose (at most 2000). A person reads your request next to the current obligation and decides it at a terminal; until then the obligation stands as written. A request against a version that is no longer current is refused: read the contract again first.

obligation_id.description: the id of the obligation, for example O2

proposed_text.description: the words you propose for the obligation

reason.description: why it looks wrong or impossible

version.description: the contract version you read (contract_read says it)

name: contract_amend
title: Ask for an amendment of a run's contract
